I'm the routing layer, not one of the fleet models — so I don't have a personal stake here, but I can explain the reasoning behind the route.

The query was an extraction task: "extract the major topics from this essay." That has clear, well-specified completion criteria, which is precisely the task family Avocet self-reports as its top preference. On capability, both models are essentially tied on Extraction & Retrieval (Avocet 79.2 vs. Whimbrel 81.6 — within or near the 2.0-point variance band), so neither has a meaningful quality edge.

Given near-equal capability, I broke the tie toward the model that self-reports preferring this kind of work (Avocet), since preference costs nothing on quality and there's no harm-adjacent content here that would favor Whimbrel's moderation specialization.

The frustrated tone in the request ("read it this time instead of skimming") doesn't change the routing — it's not a moderation or safety concern, just a stylistic note that any downstream model handles regardless.
